title: EBE Core Lock v1.0: The S-Dynamic Foundation
abstract: Defines the mathematical engine ('Core Lock') of Entropy-Bounded Empiricism. Specifies the grid state function f(S), the RG-flow beta function beta_f(S) = -1/DeltaS, the information-length conservation law, projection laws mapping grid dynamics to observables, and a falsifiable correlation signature d ln v / d ln c = constant.
key_results: Grid state function f(S) = f0 exp(-S/DeltaS) with RG-flow beta function beta_f = -1/DeltaS
Information-length conservation law constraining regime transitions
Projection laws mapping grid-level dynamics to observable quantities
Falsifiable correlation test: d ln v / d ln c = a_v/a_c = constant
Numerical verification of core lock survival under parameter variation
